title: Declassified Air Force documents on UFOs at Cold War nuclear sites
place_text: Hanford, Washington; Savannah, South Carolina; Fort Hood, Texas; Los Alamos; Malmstrom; F.E. Warren

tellings.quote: From hundreds of declassified Air Force documents, we now know that UFO sightings were happening across all American nuclear production, missile storage and deployment sites throughout the Cold War,

plain: Throughout the Cold War, UFOs were reported at every kind of American nuclear site: where weapons were made, where missiles were stored and where they were deployed. Michels says this is shown by hundreds of declassified Air Force documents, naming places such as Hanford in Washington, Savannah in South Carolina, Fort Hood in Texas, Los Alamos, and the missile bases Malmstrom and F.E. Warren. He raises it to suggest that whatever was behind the sightings was paying close attention to American nuclear weapons.
